description: This file defines the NodeId class and related classes in the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It provides abstractions for network node identifiers across various protocols and platforms, including IPv4, IPv6, Bluetooth, and others. It includes methods for handling socket information, address resolution, and interface properties.

classes.name: NodeId
classes.description: Represents a network node identifier supporting multiple protocols and platforms, with methods for address handling and comparison.

classes.name: IPNode
classes.description: Derived from NodeId, adds subnet mask handling for IP addresses.

methods.name: Extension
methods.description: Returns protocol-specific extension information based on socket family type.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the type of the node (e.g., IPv4, IPv6, Bluetooth).

methods.name: PortNumber
methods.description: Gets or sets the port number associated with the node.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the NodeId represents a valid address.

methods.name: HostName
methods.description: Retrieves the hostname associated with the NodeId.

methods.name: HostAddress
methods.description: Returns the IP address as a string.

methods.name: QualifiedName
methods.description: Returns a fully qualified name for the node.

methods.name: IsLocalInterface
methods.description: Checks if the address is a local interface.

methods.name: IsAnyInterface
methods.description: Checks if the address is a wildcard address.

methods.name: IsMulticast
methods.description: Checks if the address is multicast.

methods.name: DefaultMask
methods.description: Returns the default subnet mask for the address.

methods.name: Broadcast
methods.description: Returns a broadcast address for the NodeId.
